communication_theme_zh: 当城市开始思考——百年京张的AI原生城市文明试验场
communication_theme_en: When the City Begins to Think — Jingzhang as an AI-Native Urban-Civilisation Testbed
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ultra-wide cover background and web hero for a professional urban-planning proposal
Primary request: create a cinematic panoramic vision of the Jingzhang Railway Innovation Belt in Beijing as an AI-native urban civilization testbed, where a century-old railway heritage landscape becomes a continuous public innovation spine rather than a technology theme park
Scene/backdrop: a long elevated oblique panorama at blue hour, following the linear Jingzhang railway heritage park through Haidian; preserved railway traces, mature trees and public paths connect research campuses, mixed neighbourhoods, cultural spaces and an active station-city district; the scene should read as one coherent urban belt across north, middle and south
Subject: people-first public realm with pedestrians, elderly residents, children, wheelchair users, developers and researchers sharing ordinary civic space; subtle reversible AI layers appear as low-impact illuminated information rails, open-source exhibition markers, community service pavilions and controlled indoor testing windows; human service remains visibly present
Style/medium: high-end international urban design competition visualization, photorealistic architectural panorama, refined atmospheric realism, credible Beijing urban fabric, restrained near-future details
Composition/framing: 2.4:1 ultra-wide panorama; railway public spine sweeps from lower-left toward the distant center and returns toward the right, creating depth and continuity; preserve a calm darker band and usable negative space across the upper-left and center for later title overlay; no isolated landmark dominates
Lighting/mood: blue-hour transition from warm heritage light to cool civic innovation light, optimistic but serious, deep time and future coexistence
Color palette: deep navy, railway rust, warm amber, park green and restrained cyan accents
Materials/textures: weathered steel, brick heritage fragments, timber, native planting, permeable paving, clear glass and lightweight reversible structures
Constraints: spatially plausible, public and inclusive, technology is subtle and low-intrusion, ordinary walking and rest remain primary; no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark; concept background only, not a statutory plan or construction rendering
Avoid: cyberpunk city, neon overload, flying cars, giant robots, hologram spectacle, sci-fi skyscraper skyline, empty plazas, overly pristine generic smart-city imagery, invented Chinese signage, readable text, official emblems

outputs.post_processing: PNG palette optimization to 256 colours; no crop or content change

rights_review.portrait_status: synthetic crowd; no intentional identifiable person
